description: This Swift source file defines an enum 'ShareToAgentSettings' that manages shared user default settings related to instructions for sharing to an agent, including loading and saving a default instruction string with fallback handling.

methods.name: loadDefaultInstruction
methods.description: Returns the default instruction string from user defaults or a fallback message if none is set.

methods.name: saveDefaultInstruction
methods.description: Saves a provided instruction string into user defaults after trimming whitespace; removes the key if the string is empty.
